title: Granting of Blood Request
description: Requirements and guidelines for indigent residents of Iligan City to request blood assistance.
schedule: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Daily excluding Saturdays, Sundays and Holidays. On Mondays provision of services starts after flag raising. No noon break.

items: Signed Doctor's Blood Request (1 Original copy) - Secure from Hospital
Certificate of Indigency from Barangay (1 Original Copy) - Secure from Barangay where the patient resides
CMO Referral Slip (1 Original Copy) - Secure from City Mayor's Office - Administrative Division
For questions or clarifications, contact us at {{email:health@betteriligancity.org}} or view the {{link:/assistance|Assistance Hub}}.

procedures.providerAction: Receive and check the completeness of requirements
procedures.personInCharge: Administrative Aide V City Mayor’s Office
Administrative Aide V City Mayor’s Office

procedures.clientAction: Receive the document with the city seal to be signed by the City Mayor at the City Mayor’s Office Extension
procedures.providerAction: Release the Mayor’s Clearance and instruct client to proceed to the City Mayor’s Office Office Extension
procedures.personInCharge: Administrative Aide V City Mayor’s Office

title: PhilHealth YAKAP Registration and Availment of Benefits
description: Guidelines and procedures for registering with PhilHealth YAKAP and availing of its primary healthcare benefits, including consultations, laboratory services, and prescribed medicines.
department: Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) - YAKAP Program
whoMayAvail: Individuals seeking to register for and avail of PhilHealth YAKAP benefits.

items: PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) - Existing registered PhilHealth members may proceed to registration. Unregistered individuals must first obtain a PIN.

PIN Application - Apply online through the {{link:https://memberinquiry.philhealth.gov.ph/member/pinApplication.xhtml|PhilHealth Member Portal}} or visit the nearest PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO).

procedures.clientAction: Obtain a PhilHealth Identification Number (PIN) if not yet registered with PhilHealth. Existing registered members may proceed directly to Step 2.
procedures.providerAction: Provide the PhilHealth PIN through the Member Portal or the nearest PhilHealth Local Health Insurance Office (LHIO).
procedures.personInCharge: PhilHealth Member Services / Local Health Insurance Office

procedures.clientAction: Register for PhilHealth YAKAP through the eGovPH App, PhilHealth Member Portal, nearest PhilHealth office, or chosen YAKAP Clinic. Refer to the official list of accredited YAKAP Clinics.
procedures.providerAction: Process the member's YAKAP registration and provide access to the available YAKAP healthcare services.

procedures.clientAction: Visit the YAKAP Clinic where the member registered for an initial consultation.
procedures.providerAction: Provide primary healthcare consultation and assess the patient's medical condition.

procedures.clientAction: Undergo laboratory examinations or diagnostic tests when recommended by the attending doctor.
procedures.providerAction: Refer the patient to a diagnostic clinic or laboratory. If the YAKAP Clinic does not have the required laboratory services, refer the patient to an accredited diagnostic or laboratory clinic.
procedures.personInCharge: YAKAP Primary Care Provider / Accredited Diagnostic or Laboratory Clinic

procedures.clientAction: Obtain prescribed medicines from an accredited GAMOT provider. Present the prescription or its UPSC code to the pharmacist and submit the GAMOT Availment Slip.
procedures.providerAction: Verify the prescription and dispense the prescribed medicines through the GAMOT App. Inform the patient about the available medicine balance and applicable benefit limit.
procedures.fee: Up to Php 20,000.00 worth of medicines annually, subject to the applicable benefit coverage.

procedures.clientAction: Return to the YAKAP Clinic for scheduled follow-up consultations and continue following the doctor's medical advice.
procedures.providerAction: Monitor the patient's medical condition, evaluate treatment progress, and provide necessary follow-up consultations.
